episodes.title: The Void
episodes.summary: Wyoming rancher Royal Abbott discovers an unfathomable mystery at the edge of his property, setting in motion a catastrophic chain of events.

episodes.title: The Land
episodes.summary: The Abbott family frantically conspires to cover up their crimes but can't piece together what has happened to Royal.

episodes.title: The Time
episodes.summary: The investigation for the missing Tillerson brother forces Royal to ally with Autumn, until Amy makes an improbable discovery.

episodes.title: The Loss
episodes.summary: As word spreads about the Tillerson murder, Sheriff Joy interrogates the Abbotts, forcing Royal to wager far more than he can afford to lose.

episodes.title: The Soil
episodes.summary: Royal embarks on a quest to investigate the elusive dark mineral that is present on his land, only to intensify his growing rivalry with Autumn.

episodes.title: The Family
episodes.summary: With family ties beginning to fray, Royal takes violent measures to get rid of Autumn, but is foiled when he discovers she has manipulated someone close to him.

episodes.title: The Unknown
episodes.summary: As the Tillersons close in on the Abbott's secrets, Royal must salvage what is left of his family and livelihood; Autumn orchestrates the unthinkable.

episodes.title: The West
episodes.summary: The Abbott family faces a grand reckoning over the course of a single day as the showdown between Royal and Autumn culminates, unearthing a shattering revelation.

episodes.title: One Night in Wabang
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the bison stampede, the Abbott family is more fractured than ever. Royal and Cecilia confront some difficult truths as they fight to keep their family together.

episodes.title: Traces to Somewhere
episodes.summary: Perry seeks help from an unexpected family member. The Tillersons promise revenge against the Abbotts, while Royal contends with a new threat to the West Pasture.

episodes.title: Everybody Hurts
episodes.summary: Royal and Cecilia become desperate in their attempt to save their ranch. The Tillerson's are dealt with a startling turn of events.

episodes.title: Ode to Joy
episodes.summary: Lost in time with no way home, Sheriff Joy must navigate a new life among her Shoshone ancestors.

episodes.title: All the World's a Stage
episodes.summary: Royal rediscovers an unlikely ally; Cecilia grapples with the possibility of Autumn's identity as Autumn becomes increasingly unhinged.

episodes.title: Do-Si-Do
episodes.summary: Autumn's erratic behavior reaches a fever pitch. Royal and Cecilia take matters into their own hands.
